mn146:23.1: seyyathāpi bhaginiyo, mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato mūlampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, khandhopi anicco vipariṇāmadhammo, sākhāpalāsampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, chāyāpi aniccā vipariṇāmadhammā.
mn146:23.2: yo nu kho bhaginiyo, evaṃ vadeyya:
mn146:23.3: ‘amussa mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato mūlampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, khandhopi anicco vipariṇāmadhammo, sākhāpalāsampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ,
mn146:23.4: yā ca khvāssa chāyā sā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammo’ti.
mn146:23.5: ‘sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo, vadamāno vadeyyā’ti.
mn146:23.8: ‘amussa hi bhante mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato mūlampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, khandhopi anicco vipariṇāmadhammo, sākhāpalāsampi aniccaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ,
mn146:23.10: evameva kho bhaginiyo, yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya:
mn146:23.11: ‘cha kho me bāhirā āyatanā aniccā vipariṇāmadhammā.
mn146:23.12: yañca kho cha bāhire āyatane paṭicca paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, taṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ avipariṇāmadhamma’nti.
mn146:23.13: sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo, vadamāno vadeyyā’ti.
mn146:23.16: ‘tajjaṃ tajjaṃ bhante, paccayaṃ paṭicca tajjā tajjā vedanā uppajjanti.
mn146:23.17: tajjassa tajjassa paccayassa nirodhā tajjā tajjā vedanā nirujjhantī’ti.
mn146:23.19: evaṃ hetaṃ bhaginiyo, hoti ariyasāvakassa yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato.
mn146:24.1: seyyathāpi bhaginiyo, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā tiṇhena govikantanena gāviṃ vikanteyya, anupahacca antaraṃ maṃsakāyaṃ, anupahacca bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ.
mn146:24.2: yaṃ yadeva tattha antarā vilīmaṃsaṃ antarā nahārū, antarā bandhanaṃ, taṃ tadeva tiṇhena govikantanena sañchindeyya saṅkanteyya sampakanteyya samparikanteyya.
mn146:24.3: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ, teneva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā evaṃ vadeyya:
mn146:24.5: ‘sammā nu kho so bhaginiyo, vadamāno vadeyyā’ti.
mn146:24.8: ‘asu hi bhante, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā gāviṃ vadhitvā tiṇhena govikantanena gāviṃ vikanteyya, anupahacca antaraṃ maṃsakāyaṃ, anupahacca bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ,
mn146:24.9: yaṃ yadeva tattha antarā vilīmaṃsaṃ, antarā nahārū, antarā bandhanaṃ, taṃ tadeva tiṇhena govikantanena sañchindeyya saṅkanteyya sampakanteyya samparikanteyya.
mn146:24.10: sañchinditvā saṅkantitvā sampakantitvā samparikantitvā vidhunitvā bāhiraṃ cammakāyaṃ teneva cammena taṃ gāviṃ paṭicchādetvā kiñcāpi so evaṃ vadeyya:
mn146:24.12: atha kho sā gāvī visaṃyuttā teneva cammenā’ti.
mn146:25.1: upamā kho me ayaṃ bhaginiyo, katā atthassa viññāpanāya. ayamevettha attho:
mn146:25.2: ‘antarā maṃsakāyoti kho bhaginiyo, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.3: bāhiro cammakāyoti kho bhaginiyo, channetaṃ bāhirānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.4: antarā vilīmaṃsaṃ antarā nahārū antarā bandhananti kho bhaginiyo, nandīrāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
mn146:25.5: tiṇhaṃ govikantananti kho bhaginiyo, ariyāyetaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ,
mn146:25.6: yāyaṃ ariyā paññā antarā kilesaṃ antarā saññojanaṃ antarā bandhanaṃ sañchindati saṅkantati sampakantati samparikantati.
mn146:26.1: satta kho panime bhaginiyo, bojjhaṅgā yesaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn146:26.3: idha bhaginiyo, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
mn146:26.9: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
mn146:26.10: ime kho bhaginiyo satta bojjhaṅgā yesaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
mn146:26.11: atha kho āyasmā nandako tā bhikkhuniyo iminā ovādena ovaditvā uyyojesi:
mn146:26.13: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo āyasmato nandakassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena bhagavā, tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavā etadavoca:
mn146:26.15: atha kho tā bhikkhuniyo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
mn146:27.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantīsu tāsu bhikkhunīsu bhikkhū āmantesi:
mn146:27.2: ‘seyyathāpi bhikkhave, tadahuposathe paṇṇarase na hoti bahuno janassa kaṅkhā vā vimati vā:
mn146:27.3: ‘ūno nu kho cando puṇṇo nu kho cando’ti, atha kho puṇṇo candotveva hoti.
mn146:27.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, tā bhikkhuniyo nandakassa dhammadesanāya attamanā ceva paripuṇṇasaṅkappā ca.
mn146:27.5: tāsaṃ bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ bhikkhunīsatānaṃ yā pacchimā bhikkhunī, sā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇāti.
mn146:27.7: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
